summary: ISS-2439 (PROP-053: cross-reference scan too narrow). Extended build-scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js to scan monitor/decisions/ and monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/ in addition to monitor/analyst/expansions/ when building the mentionedIds set. Added DECISIONS_DIR and REVIEWS_DIR path constants; added scanDirForMentions() helper invoked for both. mentionedIds grows from ~20 to 78 entries. Note: the critical archive-JSONL bug (ISS-2434, pending-human) remains — orphan count is still inflated (389 vs ~60 real). This fix is scoped to ISS-2439 only.
